messages:
matt: Heads-up, need a quick onboarding perf sweep for the new model (mistral-instruct-7b-v2-q4) before we decide Dedicated capacity. Can someone run the usual suite on the a100 pool and post raw numbers/artifacts?
- p50/p95/p99 token latency (seq=512,1024)
- tokens/sec @ batch sizes [1,4,8]
- GPU peak memory, host memory, swap
- KV cache size per request
- kernel fallbacks / obvious regressions
Please paste the bench command you ran and link the artifact. Prefer within the next 2 hours if possible. thanks :pray:

jia: Running now, will upload results. I’ll run seq 512/1024, bs 1/4/8, 200 iters each on a100-80gb reserved node.

jia: Uploading quick summary + artifact: https://artifacts.internal/bench/mistral7b-q4/1716504321
Summary (a100-80gb, q4 path):
- seq=512, bs=1: p50 18 ms/token, p95 42 ms/token, p99 68 ms/token
- seq=1024, bs=1: p50 22 ms/token, p95 58 ms/token, p99 95 ms/token
- throughput (seq=512): bs1 80 tok/s, bs4 320 tok/s, bs8 560 tok/s
- GPU mem peak: 36.0 GB
- Host mem peak: 9.2 GB
- KV cache per request (seq=1024): ~6.2 GB
Notes: using q4f32 shim + int8 emulation for some ops. Saw a kernel fallback for attention on seq=1024 (flash_attn -> flash_attn_fallback) which explains higher p99.
Command used:
```
./run_bench --model mistral-instruct-7b-v2-q4 \
  --device a100 --seq 1024 --batches "1,4,8" --iters 200 \
  --quant q4f32 --out /tmp/bench/mistral7b-q4-1716504321.json
```

matt: awesome, thx. Can you also compare to our redwood-7b-q4 baseline numbers (same hw/config)? need delta for SLAs.

jia: Yep. Quick diff vs redwood-7b-q4 (same run configs):
- p50 (seq=512, bs=1): mistral +8% (18ms vs 16.7ms)
- p95 (seq=512): mistral +12%
- throughput (bs=4, seq=512): within 3% of baseline
- kv/cache memory: mistral ~6.2GB vs baseline 5.1GB
Quality: small eval run on 500 prompts, no obvious regressions.

perf-bot: CI bench summary for run 1716504321: regression detected on p50 (seq=512) +6.9% vs baseline. Full artifact: https://ci-reports/internal/1716504321

erin: tagging @ops-console — can you ingest the artifact into the perf dashboard and create a regression alert if p50 > baseline +5%? We need an SLA decision.

oliver: I’ll investigate the kernel selector — saw same fallback in local repro. Changing selector to prefer flash_attn_v2 recovered ~10-15% in a quick micro-bench on synthetic seq=1024. Opening PR now: #4287. If that lands we should re-run the suite.

matt: perfect. action items: 1) oliver PR for kernel selector, 2) jia re-run post-PR, 3) erin add dashboard entry + tag customer-facing note. ETA EOD.

jia: noted. Will re-run after PR merge, should be <1hr of runs.

matt: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
